name: Countdown
summary: Deadline-driven remaining-time counter with drift-safe shared scheduling, stable configured units, retained zero expiry, and target-owned commercial consequences.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native time element carrying one absolute deadline and the progressive-enhancement marker.

anatomy.name: fallback
anatomy.description: Localized static deadline text retained when JavaScript is unavailable or the deadline is invalid.

anatomy.name: display
anatomy.description: Generated-value presentation hidden until a valid deadline is enhanced.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Stable wrapper for one configured unit and its optional preceding separator.

anatomy.name: segment
anatomy.description: Visual value and localized unit pair.

anatomy.name: number
anatomy.description: Locale-formatted current value for one selected unit.

anatomy.name: separator
anatomy.description: Decorative separator hidden for the first selected unit.

anatomy.name: announcement
anatomy.description: Optional polite status node populated once when a supplied expiry announcement exists.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Open value-and-unit treatment without segment surfaces.

variants.name: inline
variants.description: Compact value-and-unit pairs for banners and constrained compositions.

variants.name: cards
variants.description: Each selected unit uses a padded surface.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic wrapping and tabular values adapt to the available container.

states.name: running
states.description: A valid future deadline is projected from the current clock.

states.name: expired
states.description: The deadline was reached; every selected unit remains visible at zero.

states.name: invalid
states.description: The deadline is missing, ambiguous, or invalid; only ordinary fallback content remains.

behavior.name: absoluteDeadline
attributes: datetime with explicit Z or numeric UTC offset
behavior.description: Enhancement accepts only an unambiguous absolute ISO date-time. Date-only and floating local date-time values do not become timers.

behavior.name: deadlineProjection
behavior.description: Remaining time is recomputed from deadline minus the current clock, never by decrementing stored display values.

behavior.name: sharedScheduler
behavior.description: All connected Countdown instances share one timeout scheduled for the nearest selected-unit boundary; hidden documents own no active countdown timeout and disconnected roots are pruned.

behavior.name: stableUnits
behavior.description: One non-empty ordered unit preset selects days, hours, minutes, and seconds. Selected items remain structurally stable and show explicit zeroes.

behavior.name: expiry
behavior.description: The first running-to-expired transition clamps values to zero, exposes derived state, emits one bubbling event, and optionally announces supplied neutral completion copy once.

behavior.name: targetReaction
behavior.description: Consumers may retain, hide, replace, or react to the expired state. Countdown does not infer launch, offer, price, purchase, redirect, persistence, analytics, or other domain effects.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Default, Inline, or Cards visual presentation.

properties.name: deadline
properties.description: Absolute ISO date-time including Z or a numeric UTC offset; maps to the native time datetime value.

properties.name: units
properties.description: Non-empty canonical-order selection of displayed units; all four are enabled by default.

properties.name: fallbackText
properties.description: Localized static deadline statement shown before enhancement, without JavaScript, or for an invalid deadline.

properties.name: expiredAnnouncement
properties.unsetBehavior: No live announcement is emitted; derived state and countdownexpire remain available.
properties.description: Optional localized neutral phrase announced once on a running-to-expired transition; it must not invent campaign meaning.

accessibility: Apply role=timer only after a valid deadline is actively calculated; static fallback content remains ordinary time text.
Keep the visual segments aria-hidden and expose one complete localized current phrase as the timer name.
Preserve timer's implicit aria-live=off behavior so per-unit updates are not repeatedly announced.
If supplied, announce neutral expiry copy only once; never announce every second.
Selected units remain present at zero and values never become negative.
Countdown itself is not focusable and adds no keyboard model, time-limit action, redirect, or context change.

web.notes: Canonical CSS plus components/js/theme.js implement absolute-deadline validation, localized projection, one shared visibility-aware scheduler, derived running/expired state, and a single countdownexpire event.

shopify.notes: Canonical CSS/runtime are copied, but a target-native merchant data surface and truthful placement remain intentionally unselected.
